discovery.authentication: No account or API key for template tools and creative guides. On the hosted remote, account tools need the user to link an Instavar account (OAuth). On the npm package, INSTAVAR_API_KEY unlocks separate hosted Studio workflows.
discovery.boundaries: Planning and scaffolding do not render, upload or publish media. Hosted production can incur costs. Publishing requires explicit user approval. Independent of Remotion AG.
discovery.protectedStudioNote: Separate hosted Studio surface; OAuth authentication required.
discovery.remotePlanningNote: Hosted remote listed under remotes. It serves the same free template, storyboard, carousel and paired Remotion or HyperFrames tools as the npm package, plus a ChatGPT planner widget. After the user links an Instavar account, five account tools list and review private projects, create and edit video briefs, and check render status; creating a brief starts a hosted render that uses plan credits. Workflow editing, approval, publishing and the other hosted Studio tools stay on the npm package with INSTAVAR_API_KEY or on the protected Studio endpoint.
discovery.startHere: Call get_capabilities, then list_templates and get_template before scaffolding a VideoSpec. Get local rendering instructions to produce a video on the user's machine.
